fee_notes: Mac Tools is a mobile tool franchise operating on a Route-based model with no traditional royalty or marketing fund percentage. Key ongoing fees include: (1) Annual Fee of $1,200 (prorated in first year at $100/month); (2) On-going Inventory Purchases at variable prices set by franchisor, paid weekly, with up to 2% discount if paid within 10 days; (3) Required Monthly Technology Fee up to $150/month; (4) Additional Technology Fee up to $500 initial + up to $150/month recurring; (5) Business Software Fee up to $500 initial (currently $250) + up to $150/month recurring (currently $50/month); (6) Customer Credit Program Management Fee up to 15% (currently 9%) of each customer credit purchase; (7) LTA Special Purchasing Program Administrative Fee up to 10% of purchase price (currently 5% if payment period >50 weeks; $0 if <=50 weeks); (8) ETP Administrative Fee up to $50/Route or ETP account (currently $0); (9) Late Charge of 1.5%/month (18%/year) on overdue trade account balances; (10) Restocking Fee up to 20% of purchase price on returned inventory; (11) Shipping fees vary; free on orders >$400, $25 on orders <=$400, $25 expedited; average per-shipment fee in prior fiscal year was $12.00; (12) All dollar amounts subject to CPI increases. Fees are per Route; multiple Routes require duplicating most fees.
raw_excerpt:
Annual Fee (See Note 1 and Note 11) $1,200 On or before January 15th of each full calendar year Payable in the form of a debit to your trade account.
On-going Inventory Purchases (See Note 2) Variable, depending upon type of Product purchases by franchisee Payable weekly The amount owed by you is the total price of the inventory purchased by you. The monthly or weekly amount owed will be reduced by up to 2% if amount owed is paid in full within 10 days of invoice. The total amount due is reduced by up to 2% if paid within 30 days of invoice.
Late Charge (See Note 11) 1.5% per month (18% per year) or the highest rate permitted by law (whichever is lower), based on the cash price of products purchased on a trade account and not paid when due. Payable upon demand Late charges begin when payment is 10 days past due and continues until the purchase price is paid in full.
Customer Credit Program Management Fee (See Note 3) Up to 15%, and currently 9%, of the amount of each purchase by your customer on credit under the Customer Credit Program account. Payable at the time of sale to your customer.
LTA Special Purchasing Program - Administrative Fee (See Note 4 and Note 11) Amount of this fee is up to 10% of the purchase price for each inventory eligible for the LTA Program. Fee is payable weekly by direct debit payment from your designated bank account. As of the original issuance date of this disclosure document, we do not charge an administrative fee if the franchisee's payment period is 50 weeks or less. If 51 weeks or more, we charge a fee equal to 5% of the amount of the purchase price for the item eligible for the LTA Program. During our prior fiscal year, administrative fees paid by participating franchisees ranged from $125 to $3,770.
Extended Terms Program (ETP) Special Purchasing Program - Administrative Fee (See Note 4 and Note 11) Administrative fee up to $50 for each Route operated by franchisee or each ETP account of franchisee. We estimate a participating franchisee will pay a fee of $50 to $100. Fee is payable weekly by direct debit payment from your designated bank account. Mac Tools does not currently charge an ETP administrative fee.
Required Monthly Technology Fee (See Note 5 and Note 11) Up to $150 per month. Monthly, beginning in the first full month of operation.
Additional Technology Fee (See Note 6 and Note 11) Initial fee up to $500. Monthly recurring fee up to $150. Initial fee due upon initial implementation of the Technology or other date determined by Mac Tools. Recurring fee due monthly beginning in first full month of operation.
Business Software Fees (See Note 7 and Note 11) Initial Business Software Fee up to $500, and recurring Monthly Business Software Fee of up to $150. As of the original issuance date of this disclosure document, for each Route that you operate, the initial fee is $250, and the recurring monthly fee is $50.
Renewal Fee (See Note 8 and Note 11) One-half of the then-current initial franchise fee. Payable in lump sum at the time of renewal.
Transfer Fee (See Note 9 and Note 11) Varies; one-half or full then-current initial franchise fee depending on circumstances. Prior to effectiveness of transfer.
Training Tuition Fee or Attendance Fee (See Note 10 and Note 11) Estimated maximum of $3,000 for each person trained. Payable in lump sum prior to training.
Fee for Insufficient Funds or Other Similar Reasons (See Note 11) Fee up to $50 for each occurrence. Payable in lump sum in the form of a debit to your trade account.
Restocking Fee (See Note 11) Fee up to 20% of the purchase price paid. Payable upon return of inventory to Mac Tools.
Consumer Price Index Increases to All Fees, Costs, Charges, Contributions and Dollar Amounts (See Note 11) Increase may occur no more than once per year.
Shipping Fees (See Note 11 and Note 12) Shipping costs vary. Free shipping on orders over $400, a $25 charge for orders of $400 or less, and an expedited shipping fee of $25. During our prior fiscal year, the average fee per shipment was $12.00.
